statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-8149 affects Bouncy Castle BC-FJA BC-FIPS 2.1.0 through 2.1.2 on Linux X86_64 with AVX/AVX-512f. The vulnerability is associated with GCM cipher implementations (gcm128w, gcm512w). No upstream fix is available yet for the 2.1.x line. The practical impact is limited to specific hardware configurations with AVX-512f support. This CVE is under investigation pending upstream release of a patched version.
